component-o.description-s: 4.5-17 V input, 2 A, 580 kHz synchronous step-down converter, D-CAP2, adjustable output, SOT-23-6 (DDC)

pin_sources-ao.function-s: Ground: low-side NFET source and controller ground
pin_sources-ao.connection-s: GND (avss); VFB divider bottom returns here
pin_sources-ao.required-s: Ground; connect sensitive VFB to this GND at a single point (Table 4-1)

also-o.figure-s: Figure 7-1 TPS562201 and TPS562208 1.05-V/2-A Reference Design

pin_sources-ao.function-s: Switch node between high-side and low-side NFETs
pin_sources-ao.connection-s: 3.3 uH from SW to VOUT (3.3uh-vout); 100 nF bootstrap from VBST
pin_sources-ao.required-s: For 5 V out: L1 3.3 min / 4.7 typ / 4.7 max uH (Table 7-2 p14); EVM L1 3.3 uH
pin_sources-ao.note-s: Record uses the Table 7-2 minimum (3.3 uH, also the EVM value), not the 4.7 uH typical.

also-o.figure-s: Figure 7-1 TPS562201 and TPS562208 1.05-V/2-A Reference Design

pin_sources-ao.function-s: Input supply; drain of the high-side NFET
pin_sources-ao.connection-s: input power via ds-power-rx; 10 uF + 100 nF to GND (10uf-avss, 100nf-avss)
pin_sources-ao.required-s: 'TI recommends a ceramic capacitor over 10 uF for the decoupling capacitor'; optional extra 0.1 uF (C3) from pin 3 to ground (7.2.2.4 p14); Figure 7-1: 2 x 10 uF + 0.1 uF; EVM C2 + C3 10 uF + C1 0.1 uF
pin_sources-ao.note-s: Record has one 10 uF; the text asks for over 10 uF and both the reference design and the EVM fit 2 x 10 uF. Within the letter only if derating is ignored; raise if the board sees large input ripple.

also-o.figure-s: Figure 7-1 TPS562201 and TPS562208 1.05-V/2-A Reference Design

pin_sources-ao.connection-s: R1 54.9k to VOUT (54.9k-vout), R2 10k to GND (10k-avss): 5 V out
pin_sources-ao.required-s: Connect to the output through a feedback divider (Table 4-1); 5 V row: R1 54.9 k, R2 10.0 k, C8 + C9 20 to 68 uF (Table 7-2 p14)

also-o.table-s: Table 7-2 Recommended Component Values (continued), 5 V row

pin_sources-ao.required-s: Active high and must be pulled up to enable the device (Table 4-1); VIN, EN abs max 19 V (5.1 p4); EVM: R4 10.0k from VIN to EN (JP1); Figure 7-1: R3 10.0 k to an EN signal
Connect a 0.1 uF capacitor between VBST and SW (Table 4-1; 7.2.2.5 p14); EVM C4 0.1 uF via R5 0 Ohm

also-o.figure-s: Figure 7-1 TPS562201 and TPS562208 1.05-V/2-A Reference Design

cfgpins-ao.5c: EN active high, must be pulled up (VENH 1.6 V); rated to 17 V like VIN, so tied to VIN

cfgpins-ao.4c: VFB 0.768 V; datasheet table (p14): 5 V out = R1 54.9k / R2 10k, L 3.3 uH, COUT 20-68 uF (2 x 22 uF)

load_regulation_source-o.derived-s: read by procurement pdf-graph (vector): +0.1451 % at 0.5 A, -0.6184 % at 2 A (continuous-conduction region; below 0.5 A Eco-mode raises VOUT); 0.7635 % x 1050 mV = 8.02 mV over 1.5 A = 5.34 mV/A. VIN = 12 V (Figure 7-3): +0.174 % -> -0.573 % = 5.23 mV/A; the larger is kept. No load-regulation row in the Electrical Characteristics

tps562201.pdf (SLVSD91D) p7 Figure 5-12 'TPS562201 VOUT = 3.3 V Efficiency, L = 3.3 uH', Vin = 9 V curve at 1.5 A, read by procurement pdf-graph (0.907)

specs-o.efficiency_note-s: No efficiency curve for VOUT above 5 V: the board's point (9 V in, 7.07 V out, 2 A) is not stated. The nearest stated curve is VOUT 5 V at Vin 9 V, 91.5 % at 1.988 A (Figure 5-13 p8). | Added VIN5V typical curve data for VOUT1.05/1.8/3.3V (SLVSD91D p7 Figures5-9/5-11/5-12). Local deterministic pdf-graph vector extraction; red VIN5V trace visually verified. Points200/500/1000/1900mA interpolated only between curve vertices on the logarithmic load axis, rounded0.1 percentage point; assign about +/-1 percentage point plot-reading uncertainty, not a manufacturer tolerance. Temperature is not stated beside these plots. L=2.2uH for1.05/1.8V,3.3uH for3.3V. Exact VOUT1.1V is not published; do not relabel1.05V or extrapolate from VIN9V. Different inductors/temperature require explicit model qualification. These are typical efficiencies, not guaranteed lower bounds.
